meta.name: gtars
meta.description: Use Gtars for local genomic interval models and set algebra, overlaps and counts, consensus and coverage, tokenization, fragment processing, and refget/BEDbase planning across Python, Rust, and the CLI.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析基因组区间,找出序列间的重叠与覆盖
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果在做基因组科研,需要比较不同区间的对应关系。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze genomic intervals and find overlaps between sequences
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work in genomics and need to compare DNA intervals.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 可以用 gtars 对基因组区间文件(BED)做重叠检测、生成 WIG/BigWig 覆盖度轨道、把区域转成机器学习用的 token、按参考基因组取序列、拆分和打分单细胞片段等。
howto.when: 当你要求做基因组区间分析,如 BED 文件处理、区域重叠检测、覆盖度轨道生成(BigWig 等)时触发。

say.text: 用 gtars 读 BED,找与启动子重叠的峰并导出。
say.note: 会用 IGD 建立索引并查询重叠区间。

say.text: 把 fragments.bed 用 uniwig 生成 BigWig 覆盖轨道。
say.note: 运行 CLI 生成 coverage 文件。

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude can use gtars to detect overlaps among genomic interval files (BED), generate WIG/BigWig coverage tracks, convert regions into ML tokens, fetch reference sequences, and split/score single-cell fragments.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to analyze BED-formatted intervals, find overlaps between genomic regions, generate coverage tracks (e.g., BigWig), etc.

say_en.text: Use gtars to read a BED and export peaks overlapping promoters.
say_en.note: Builds an IGD index and queries overlaps.

say_en.text: Generate a BigWig coverage track from fragments.bed with uniwig.
say_en.note: Runs the CLI to produce a coverage file.

say_en.text: Use TreeTokenizer from a BED to tokenize chr1:1000-2000.
say_en.note: Produces discrete tokens for ML preprocessing.
